annotations.title: Show a job’s application form in the chat

description: Use this when the user wants to apply for a job (Bewerbung, Formular) and get_form_fields gave `ansicht`: shows the form in the chat to consent, read and answer it. Call it once per job, as the last step of your turn, then end the turn without a word about the form; the answers come as the user’s message. Scope: cv:lesen.
name: show_application_form
title: Show a job’s application form in the chat
